verdict.rationale: dlt is documented as an open-source Python library installable via pip that runs wherever Python runs: a laptop, notebook, Airflow, Dagster, Lambda or container, with local DuckDB destinations. Community adopters describe dropping it into their own existing stacks. Missing for 10: no explicit license terms in the evidence, and no evidence that the dltHub platform layer (Web UI at app.dlthub.com, managed deploy and orchestration) can be self-hosted.
